QF.id: Role of RTAs in Mutual Fund Transactions_25

question.text: By what time must the NAV of most mutual fund schemes (other than Fund of Fund schemes) be uploaded on the AMFI website?

answer.text: 9 PM on the same business day
10 AM on the next business day (T+1)
3 PM on the same business day
11 PM on the same business day (T-day)

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that all mutual fund schemes, except Fund of Fund schemes, must update the latest NAV on the AMFI website by 11 PM on the same business day (T-day). The Trap: Fund of Fund schemes are the workbook-stated exception to the 11 PM deadline; they have a separate later deadline of 10 AM on the following business day. Do not assume the 11 PM rule covers every type of scheme. Note: For Fund of Fund schemes the deadline is 10 AM the following business day. Any other category-specific deadlines (e.g., for overseas fund schemes) should only be cited from a separately verified SEBI source.
